storyline.real: Alonso leads from pole on a dry track after a wet qualifying. Button, sixth on the grid, passes Schumacher and Hülkenberg early. McLaren stop him a lap before Vettel for the last time, and a 2.3 s stop puts him ahead of the Red Bull. He holds Vettel off until Vettel goes round the outside at the hairpin on the penultimate lap, using the run-off. Vettel's 20 s penalty gives Button second, 6.949 s behind Alonso.
storyline.headline: Button's quick stops carry McLaren past Alonso at Hockenheim

mastery.label: Finish P2 or better on two stops, as Button did

hidden.label: Finish P2 or better without a lap managing the tyres

eras.briefing: Hockenheim, 2012. Alonso took pole in the wet, but the race is dry. You run Button third after 16 laps, 7.7 s behind Alonso's Ferrari and 5.5 s behind Vettel's Red Bull. McLaren's pit crew is fast: time your stops to jump the Red Bull, then go after the Ferrari.
